g.title: rows
g.text: node 5, 15 bp, the one node a route visits
follows R from 1+ to 4+ by route 0
follows R from 1+ to 4+ by route 1
follows R from 1+ to 4+, no routes
Every row starts GRCh38#0#chr1 0 1, the chunk's first base, so a query returns whole 64 kb chunks.
The file holds each distinct route once, and a walk row lists only the routes its path takes. The
bold tokens code R's steps as 2 × node id + strand and each walk's routes as 2 × route id + flip,
both as deltas from the token before; docs/walks-format.md decodes them.
